run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T22:05:50Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend-proxy alert is corroborated only indirectly: the proxy's traced error spans burst to ~0.256/s on both of its operations ("ingress" and "router frontend egress") in the 5-minute windows ending 21:58:50 and 22:00:50 and were back to their 0.0074/s-level background by the window ending 22:02:50. The deepest error signal along that path is checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (ERROR at 0.1945/s ending 21:59 and 0.163/s ending 22:01), together with checkout's own oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder; frontend's POST /api/checkout family carried ~70.5 error spans over 21:55-22:17 while cart/product/currency paths carried none, and payment's own server span carried no ERROR status. At 21:56:12 the payment Deployment was replaced by revision 2 (ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786) with a kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt annotation and an otherwise identical pod template (same image, env, resources); the old pod was stopped at 21:56:15 and the new payment container only logged "payment gRPC server started on port 8080" at 21:57:30.571Z, with 1 replica and no readiness probe to gate traffic. The only fault-injection setting switched on in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config is paymentUnreachable (defaultVariant "on", "Payment service is unavailable"); every other fault flag there is "off". Hypothesis (not directly observed): that setting is the injected fault behind the payment-path failures; an alternative mechanism is the ~75-second no-listener window created by the rollout restart. The declared fault itself, the restart's trigger and the alert rule were not observable in this Run, so the conclusion is partial and no verified root cause can be promoted beyond the candidate named below.

claims.text: At 22:10:00Z frontend-proxy had STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate 0.0105/s against STATUS_CODE_UNSET 21.64/s, i.e. a small residual error rate on this service after the burst.

frontend-proxy error-span rate by operation over 21:05:50-22:14:50 (5m rate, 120s steps) sat at 0-0.0148/s for "ingress" and 0 for "router frontend egress", then reached 0.2556/s (ingress) and 0.2556/s (egress) in the windows ending 21:58:50 and 0.2593/s / 0.2593/s in the windows ending 22:00:50, falling back to 0.0074/s (ingress) and 0 (egress) by the window ending 22:02:50.
frontend-proxy exposes exactly two span operations, "ingress" and "router frontend egress", so the entire error burst was on the proxy's inbound request span and its outbound call to frontend.

checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and its server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder recorded STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.1945/s (window ending 21:59:00) and 0.163/s (window ending 22:01:00) and 0 at the points from 22:03:00 to 22:15:00; checkout's other operations (oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, HTTP POST, orders publish, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart) show no ERROR status in that query.

payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge returned no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series over 21:45-22:15 (only STATUS_CODE_UNSET), while payment's GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect error series were present and equal to 0 throughout.

frontend's error-span increases over the 22-minute window ending 22:17:00 were concentrated on the checkout path: POST 70.55, POST /api/checkout 70.55, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 70.55 and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 70.55 error spans, while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds had 0.

Deployment payment was rolled at 21:56:12: new ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 (deployment revision 2) was created at 2026-11-17T21:56:12Z carrying pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T21:56:12Z, with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, the same eight environment variables, the same resources and no command/args as revision-1 ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9, which is now at 0 replicas.

Events for the rollout: pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d Scheduled 21:56:12Z, image Pulled 21:56:14Z, container Created 21:56:14Z, Started 21:56:15Z; old pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 "Stopping container payment" 21:56:15Z; Deployment payment "Scaled up replica set payment-54499f9786 from 0 to 1" 21:56:12Z and "Scaled down replica set payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0" 21:56:15Z; ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 SuccessfulCreate and payment-55766d76b9 SuccessfulDelete.

Pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d (the only payment pod) is phase Running, container ready, restartCount 0, status.startTime 2026-11-17T21:56:12Z and no lastTerminated reason, i.e. it did not crash or OOM.

The new payment container logged "payment gRPC server started on port 8080" at 2026-11-17T21:57:30.571Z, about 75 seconds after its Started event at 21:56:15Z, and it has no previous container instance.
Deployment payment runs 1 replica with strategy RollingUpdate maxUnavailable 25% and defines no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe on its payment container.

Once listening, the new payment pod served charges normally: interleaved "Charge request received." / "Transaction complete." lines were emitted continuously from 22:03:05Z to 22:05:58Z in the read log window, with no error lines in the excluded-filter view of 21:56:00-22:00:00 apart from the startup line.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (data key demo.flagd.json) sets flag "paymentUnreachable" to defaultVariant "on" with description "Payment service is unavailable", state ENABLED and variants off=false/on=true, while every other fault flag in the same file (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) has defaultVariant "off".

The alerted service's own object was not restarted: Deployment frontend-proxy is still deployment revision 1 (created 21:23:59Z) and its pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks has 0 restarts and is Running.

Sparse STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on the flagd evaluation streams of ad (flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream), fraud-detection and recommendation (/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream) are present across 21:45-22:10 at 0 or about 0.0037/s, i.e. before, during and after the frontend-proxy error burst, so they are continuous background rather than the deviation.

The error burst did not originate in frontend-proxy's own processing: its only error-bearing spans are its server span "ingress" and its client span "router frontend egress" to frontend, and the deepest failing span observed is checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, while payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries no ERROR status and payment logged successful transactions after 21:57:30.

Candidate root cause: the fault-injection setting "paymentUnreachable": {"defaultVariant": "on"} held in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config is the injected fault behind the checkout-to-payment failures that surfaced at frontend-proxy. It is the only fault setting switched on, its name/description refer to the payment service, and payment is the workload that was replaced at 21:56:12 with an unchanged pod template. The declared fault itself (sustained payment unreachability) was not observed and the time the setting was changed is unknown.

Alternative mechanism for the same failures: the payment rollout left a window with no listening payment gRPC server. The old pod was stopped at 21:56:15 while the replacement only began listening at 21:57:30; with 1 replica, no readiness probe and maxUnavailable 25% (which rounds to 0 but is irrelevant without a readiness gate) the Service endpoint was the new but not-yet-listening pod, so checkout's Charge calls failed and propagated as PlaceOrder errors, frontend 500s and frontend-proxy ingress errors. The measured burst intervals (elevated in the 5m windows ending 21:58:50 and 22:00:50, background by 22:02:50) are consistent with this gap.

Make the payment rollout non-disruptive: add a readinessProbe (and startupProbe) on the payment gRPC port so traffic is only sent once the server listens, run more than one replica or set a grace period via preStop/terminationGracePeriod, and check why the Node.js payment process needs ~75s to reach "gRPC server started" under its 20m CPU limit.

Before changing anything, confirm via cluster audit/change history who issued the rollout restart on Deployment payment at 2026-11-17T21:56:12Z and when the "paymentUnreachable" defaultVariant in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config became "on"; the change_history integration is not available in this Run.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what issued the payment rollout restart at 2026-11-17T21:56:12Z (kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt) and when ConfigMap flagd-config's paymentUnreachable was switched to "on" cannot be determined.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not loaded in the queried Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules returned nothing for rule_name RequestErrorRate and for all rules), so the alert expression, threshold and evaluation window are unknown, and the reported value 0.0222 could not be reproduced: the frontend-proxy error-span ratio at 22:05:50 over a 5m window was 0.00056. The alert start (22:05:50) is later than the error burst, which is unexplained without the rule.

No gRPC error code/message was obtainable for the failed Charge calls: Jaeger's newest returned frontend traces are 21:51:37-21:51:42 (all HTTP 200 / grpc status 0) and traces_search for frontend-proxy and for checkout over the failure window returned no traces, so the error text behind the checkout client-span errors is unknown.
Logs of the previous (pre-restart) payment pod are gone (pod deleted; "previous terminated container not found"), so whether that instance logged errors before 21:56:15 is unknown.
A grep of checkout pod logs for err|error|fail|fatal|panic|unavailable|deadline|refused over 21:50-22:06 returned no lines, so no application-level error text from checkout is available.

kube-state-metrics series (kube_pod_container_info, kube_deployment_status_replicas_*, kube_replicaset_owner) returned no data in this Prometheus, so image digests could not be compared between the old and new payment pods; the "config-only" nature of the rollout rests on the two ReplicaSet pod templates (same image tag, env, resources) rather than on image_id.
The flagd pod's container logs were empty in the queried window, so no record of a flags-file reload or change was found.
Queries for NetworkPolicy and ResourceQuota objects returned nothing; an empty result is not proof of absence and their state at 21:56:12 is unknown.

Sub-minute timing of the burst is not consistent across resolutions: the 1m-rate view shows 0 at 21:57:00-21:59:00 with no samples at 21:58:00 and 22:00:00, while the 2m and 5m views show the spike; the burst can only be bounded to roughly 21:56-22:02.

The declared effect of paymentUnreachable (payments unreachable) was not observed as a sustained condition: payment logged successful charges from 21:57:30 onward while the flag remains "on". Whether the flag is inert, was set only briefly, or works through a mechanism not visible here remains unknown.
next_steps: Pull Kubernetes audit logs / GitOps history for Deployment otel-demo/payment around 2026-11-17T21:56:12Z and for ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config to identify who changed the paymentUnreachable flag and who triggered the rollout restart.
Review the flagd-ui/flagd configuration history for otel-demo to see when paymentUnreachable switched from "off" to "on".
Reproduce or read the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition (it is not present in the queried Prometheus) to confirm which signal and window produced 0.0222 at 22:05:50.
Retain traces long enough to cover such incidents (currently no traces after ~21:51:42) so the gRPC error code of failed oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge calls can be read in future.
